out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hot water at the handwashing sink and dump sink, by the drive through window, was not 100 F. Maximum temperature observed were 85F and 96F, respectively.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: French fries =120F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI-Fries discarded

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Equipment Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: The INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR SURFACES of the mechanical warewashing machine are soiled with debris that may decrease the effectiveness of the unit.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine, the compartments of sinks, basins, or other receptacles used for washing and rinsing equipment, utensils, or raw foods, or laundering wiping cloths and drainboards or other equipment used to substitute for drainboards shall be cleaned before use, throughout the day at a frequency necessary to prevent recontamination of equipment and utensils and to ensure that the equipment performs its intended function and if used at least every 24 hours. FREDDY'S FROZEN CUSTARD (Inspection Date: 05/12/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted ice deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: interior of small glass display freezer heart the drive through window.
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: HOT WATER HEATER,
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacles, Provided for Paper Towel Disposal
violations.observation: There is no refuse container at the area immediately adjacent to the hand sink located in the dish machine and 3-vat sink area.
violations.corrective_action: If disposable paper towels are used at handwashing sinks, a trash can shall be located at each sink or group of adjacent sinks.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the walls are damaged at various locations within the facility and not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS UNDER SHELVING, INSIDE THE WALK-IN FREEZER , WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR, AND THROUGHOUT THE FACILITY, ARE in need of cleaning.THE MFLOOR INSIDE THE WALK-IN FREEZER AND REFRIGERATOR HAS IMBEDDED DIRT under the shelves and on the isle.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean the floors thoroughly to prevent attracting pests in to the facility.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: EHS OBSERVED RAW GROUND HAMBURGER ABOVE HOT DOGS, WHOLE RAW ONIONS, AND BAGS OF CHILI ON RACK IN WALK IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC RELOCATED RAW GROUND HAMBURGER TO BOTTOM OF RACK.
